[[File:Ryshcate.png|150px|thumb|Ryshcate]]
{{Quote|We share this ryshcate in the same way we share our celebration of life.''"<br />"''To the celebration of life.|Traditional ryshcate toast|<ref name="X-Wing: Rogue Squadron">''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]''</ref>}}
'''Ryshcate''' was a dark [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Sweetcake/Legends|sweetcake]] that originated from [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. It was used to mark special occasions (such as birthdays<ref name="swg">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=item|Ryshcate}}</ref>) and to remember the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] when Corellians were offworld. [[Mirax Terrik Horn|Mirax Terrik]] presented [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] with a ryshcate as a peace offering after he was wounded on [[Talasea]], beginning their courtship. One of the more well-known ingredients was quality [[Corellian whiskey/Legends|Corellian whiskey]], and it also contained [[vweilu nut]]s.<ref name="XW:RS">''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]''</ref> [[Custo Ramak]]'s famous deathbed work describing his life in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] was entitled ''[[Nights of Ryscate and Diamonds]]''.
